title: Covariate-Indexed Inclusion Probabilities on Unbalanced Panels
abstract: arXiv:2611.22730v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We estimate the probability that an item with given covariates belongs to a set when the cross-section changes over time and items and periods are dependent. We propose two convex models whose fitted probabilities are nonnegative by construction and remain valid whatever the dependence between items, for which we establish consistency, finite-sample bounds and limit distributions for serially dependent panels. One suits events of moderate or high probability, the other rare events, and half the disagreement between their fits estimates a lower bound on the misspecification error of the worse fit, without knowledge of the true probabilities. On monthly US stock failures, the rare-event model predicts better than the ordinary logit and the classical failure logit. With the eight classical predictors, most of the gain comes from basis functions of the rank angle of each predictor and summary.

translated_title: 非平衡面板上以协变量为索引的包含概率
translated_abstract: 当横截面随时间变化且个体与时期之间存在相依性时，我们估计具有给定协变量的个体属于某个集合的概率。我们提出两个凸模型，其拟合概率在构造上非负，且无论个体之间依赖关系如何均保持有效；对于序列相依面板，我们为这些模型建立了一致性、有限样本界和极限分布。其中一个模型适用于中等或高概率事件，另一个适用于罕见事件，且两者拟合结果之间分歧的一半可以在不知道真实概率的情况下估计出较差模型的误设误差下界。在美国股票月度失败（退市）数据上，罕见事件模型的预测效果优于普通logit模型和经典的失败logit模型。在使用八个经典预测变量时，大部分增益来自每个预测变量秩角度的基函数及其汇总。
tldr: 本文提出两个凸模型以估计非平衡面板中协变量索引的包含概率，模型保证概率非负且对任意个体依赖结构有效，两者拟合分歧的一半可在不知真值的情况下估计较差模型的误设误差下界，并在美国股票月度失败预测中优于传统logit模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two convex models for estimating covariate-indexed inclusion probabilities on unbalanced panels, guaranteeing nonnegative fitted probabilities valid under arbitrary dependence, with half the disagreement between their fits providing a misspecification error bound without true probabilities, and the rare-event model outperforming standard logits on US stock failure prediction.
